# ElfUI (full reference)

> ElfUI is a dark-only design system for Vue 3 and Nuxt 4, built on Reka UI and Tailwind CSS v4, with two themes: elf (violet, rounded) and novatron (gold on obsidian, sharp corners).

Version 0.2.0. Docs: https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/ . Source: https://github.com/xouyi/elfUI .

## Rules for AI assistants

- Use ElfUI components (ElfButton, ElfInput, ElfBadge, ElfCard, ElfDialog, ElfTabs) instead of hand-rolling buttons, inputs, badges, cards, dialogs or tabs.
- Choose appearance with props (variant, size), not custom classes or inline styles.
- Style with theme tokens (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, border-border), never hard-coded colors (no #hex, no bg-violet-500).
- ElfUI is dark only: do not add light-mode styles or dark: variants.
- Do not override border radius with arbitrary values; radii derive from the theme (novatron is sharp, 0px).
- Components are auto-imported in Nuxt with the Elf prefix; outside Nuxt import them from "@elf/ui".
- Always label inputs (label for= or aria-label) and give icon-only buttons an aria-label.
- Dialogs need a title and description; tabs lists need an aria-label.
- Keep exactly one primary (default variant) button per view; use destructive only for irreversible actions.
- Install from a pinned GitHub tag (github:xouyi/elfUI#vX.Y.Z); typescript 5 or 6 (not 7) must be installed in the consumer project.
- Use Bun for all package commands (bun add, bun run, bunx), never npm, pnpm or yarn.

### Novatron theme rules

- Use data-theme="novatron" (or elf: { theme: "novatron" } in nuxt.config) for anything representing Novatron Robotics (FRC Team 10202).
- Palette: obsidian black background (#050505 / #09090b) and Novatron gold (#ffcc00) primary. 100% dark mode.
- Geometry is sharp: 0px border radius everywhere. Never add rounded-* overrides or rounded arbitrary values.
- Downstream user-facing copy for Novatron apps is Turkish; code, identifiers and comments are English.

## Install (Nuxt 4)

Requirements: Bun, Nuxt 4, Tailwind CSS v4 with @tailwindcss/vite, typescript 5 or 6 as a dev dependency (`typescript@5`; the Vue compiler needs its JavaScript API to resolve Reka UI prop types, which TypeScript 7 no longer exposes).

```bash
bun add github:xouyi/elfUI#v0.2.0 tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
bun add -d typescript@5
```

```ts
// nuxt.config.ts
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite'

export default defineNuxtConfig({
  modules: ['@elf/ui/nuxt'],
  css: ['~/assets/css/main.css'],
  elf: { theme: 'novatron', themes: ['elf'] }, // theme: 'elf' | 'novatron'
  vite: { plugins: [tailwindcss()] },
})
```

```css
/* app/assets/css/main.css */
@import 'tailwindcss';
@import '@elf/ui/styles.css';
```

Components are auto-imported with the Elf prefix. Module options: `theme` ('elf' | 'novatron', default 'elf'), `themes` (extra theme CSS to bundle), `prefix` (default 'Elf').

Upgrade: `bun remove @elf/ui && bun add github:xouyi/elfUI#vX.Y.Z`.

## Install (Vue + Vite, no Nuxt)

```css
@import 'tailwindcss';
@import '@elf/ui/styles.css';
@import '@elf/ui/themes/elf.css';
@import '@elf/ui/themes/novatron.css';
```

```ts
import { ElfButton } from '@elf/ui'
```

Set `<html data-theme="elf">` (or `novatron`).

## Registry (copy components)

```bash
bunx shadcn-vue@latest add https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/r/button.json
```

Or register `"@elf": "https://xouyi.github.io/elfUI/r/{name}.json"` under `registries` in components.json and run `bunx shadcn-vue@latest add @elf/button @elf/elf-theme`. Items: utils, button, input, badge, card, dialog, tabs, visually-hidden, label, separator, kbd, spinner, skeleton, textarea, field, elf-theme. Fallback host: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xouyi/elfUI/main/registry/r/{name}.json

## Theming

Themes: `elf`, `novatron`. Select with `data-theme` on html or any element. Dark only.

```ts
document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'novatron'
```

Tokens (CSS variables `--elf-<name>`, Tailwind utilities `bg-<name>`, `text-<name>-foreground`, `border-border`, `ring-ring`):

| Token | elf | novatron |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| background | `oklch(0.145 0.012 295)` | `#050505` |
| foreground | `oklch(0.97 0.005 295)` | `#fafafa` |
| card | `oklch(0.19 0.02 295)` | `#09090b` |
| card-foreground | `oklch(0.97 0.005 295)` | `#fafafa` |
| popover | `oklch(0.21 0.022 295)` | `#09090b` |
| popover-foreground | `oklch(0.97 0.005 295)` | `#fafafa` |
| primary | `oklch(0.7 0.16 293)` | `#ffcc00` |
| primary-foreground | `oklch(0.15 0.03 295)` | `#050505` |
| secondary | `oklch(0.27 0.035 295)` | `#18181b` |
| secondary-foreground | `oklch(0.97 0.005 295)` | `#fafafa` |
| muted | `oklch(0.24 0.025 295)` | `#18181b` |
| muted-foreground | `oklch(0.72 0.03 295)` | `#a1a1aa` |
| accent | `oklch(0.32 0.07 295)` | `#27272a` |
| accent-foreground | `oklch(0.98 0.005 295)` | `#fafafa` |
| destructive | `oklch(0.55 0.21 25)` | `#dc2626` |
| destructive-foreground | `oklch(0.99 0 0)` | `#ffffff` |
| success | `oklch(0.72 0.17 150)` | `#22c55e` |
| success-foreground | `oklch(0.15 0.03 150)` | `#050505` |
| warning | `oklch(0.82 0.15 85)` | `#f59e0b` |
| warning-foreground | `oklch(0.2 0.04 85)` | `#050505` |
| border | `oklch(0.3 0.03 295)` | `#27272a` |
| input | `oklch(0.52 0.05 295)` | `#71717a` |
| ring | `oklch(0.7 0.16 293)` | `#ffcc00` |
| radius | `0.625rem` | `0px` |
| radius-pill | `9999px` | `0px` |

Create a theme: add a CSS file declaring every token under `[data-theme='name']`, import it after styles.css, then run `bun run contrast` (WCAG AA).

## Components

### Button

Triggers an action. Renders a native button; use as-child to render a link or other element.

Components: `ElfButton`

- variant options: `default`, `secondary`, `outline`, `ghost`, `destructive`, `link` (default `default`)
- size options: `default`, `sm`, `lg`, `icon` (default `default`)

Props:

- `variant` (variant union, default default): Visual style.
- `size` (size union, default default): Size. Use icon for square icon-only buttons.
- `as` (string | Component, default button): Element to render.
- `asChild` (boolean, default false): Render the child element with Button styling (attribute: as-child).
- `class` (string | array | object): Merged with base classes via cn().

Slots:

- default: button content (text and icons)

Accessibility:

- Icon-only buttons (size="icon") must have an aria-label.
- Use as-child with a link for navigation.

Examples:

#### As Child

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfButton as-child>
    <a href="#docs">Documentation</a>
  </ElfButton>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfButton>Button</ElfButton>
</template>
```

#### Disabled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfButton disabled>
    Disabled
  </ElfButton>
</template>
```

#### Sizes

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton } from '@elf/ui'
import { Plus } from '@lucide/vue'

const sizes = ['sm', 'default', 'lg'] as const
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
    <ElfButton v-for="size in sizes" :key="size" :size="size">
      {{ size }}
    </ElfButton>
    <ElfButton size="icon" aria-label="Add">
      <Plus />
    </ElfButton>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Variants

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton } from '@elf/ui'

const variants = ['default', 'secondary', 'outline', 'ghost', 'destructive', 'link'] as const
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
    <ElfButton v-for="variant in variants" :key="variant" :variant="variant">
      {{ variant }}
    </ElfButton>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### With Icon

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton } from '@elf/ui'
import { Plus } from '@lucide/vue'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfButton>
    <Plus /> New item
  </ElfButton>
</template>
```

### Input

Single-line text input with v-model. A native input: all native attributes fall through.

Components: `ElfInput`

Props:

- `modelValue` (string | number): Bound with v-model.
- `defaultValue` (string | number): Initial value when uncontrolled.
- `class` (string | array | object): Merged with base classes.

Accessibility:

- Always provide a visible label (label for=) or aria-label; a placeholder is not a label.
- Set aria-invalid="true" for errors and describe the error in text.

Examples:

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfInput } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfInput placeholder="Email address" aria-label="Email" class="w-72" />
</template>
```

#### Disabled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfInput } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfInput disabled placeholder="Disabled" aria-label="Disabled" class="w-72" />
</template>
```

#### File

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfInput } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfInput type="file" aria-label="File" class="w-72" />
</template>
```

#### Invalid

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfInput } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-72 gap-2">
    <ElfInput aria-invalid="true" model-value="not-an-email" aria-label="Email" aria-describedby="email-error" />
    <p id="email-error" class="text-sm text-[color-mix(in_oklab,var(--color-destructive)_55%,white)]">
      Enter a valid email address.
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### With Label

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfInput } from '@elf/ui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const email = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-72 gap-2">
    <label for="email" class="text-sm font-medium">Email</label>
    <ElfInput id="email" v-model="email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
    <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      Value: {{ email || 'empty' }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Badge

Small pill for status and labels. Static text unless rendered as a link or button with as-child.

Components: `ElfBadge`

- variant options: `default`, `secondary`, `outline`, `destructive`, `success`, `warning` (default `default`)

Props:

- `variant` (variant union, default default): Visual style.
- `as` (string | Component, default span): Element to render.
- `asChild` (boolean, default false): Render the child element with Badge styling.
- `class` (string | array | object): Merged with base classes.

Slots:

- default: badge text

Accessibility:

- Do not rely on color alone: the text must state the status.

Examples:

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfBadge } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfBadge>Badge</ElfBadge>
</template>
```

#### Variants

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfBadge } from '@elf/ui'

const variants = ['default', 'secondary', 'outline', 'destructive', 'success', 'warning'] as const
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
    <ElfBadge v-for="variant in variants" :key="variant" :variant="variant">
      {{ variant }}
    </ElfBadge>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Card

Container for grouped content, composed from parts.

Components: `ElfCard`, `ElfCardHeader`, `ElfCardTitle`, `ElfCardDescription`, `ElfCardAction`, `ElfCardContent`, `ElfCardFooter`

Props:

- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by every part; merged with base classes.

Slots:

- default on every part
- ElfCardAction sits top-right inside ElfCardHeader

Accessibility:

- A card is a plain div; choose heading semantics for the title yourself.
- If the whole card is a link, link the title rather than wrapping the card.

Examples:

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfBadge, ElfButton, ElfCard, ElfCardAction, ElfCardContent, ElfCardDescription, ElfCardFooter, ElfCardHeader, ElfCardTitle } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfCard class="w-full max-w-sm">
    <ElfCardHeader>
      <ElfCardTitle>Robot status</ElfCardTitle>
      <ElfCardDescription>Drivetrain diagnostics for the last match.</ElfCardDescription>
      <ElfCardAction>
        <ElfBadge variant="success">
          Ready
        </ElfBadge>
      </ElfCardAction>
    </ElfCardHeader>
    <ElfCardContent>
      <p class="text-sm">
        All swerve modules calibrated. Battery at 12.4 V.
      </p>
    </ElfCardContent>
    <ElfCardFooter class="gap-2">
      <ElfButton size="sm">
        Open log
      </ElfButton>
      <ElfButton size="sm" variant="outline">
        Dismiss
      </ElfButton>
    </ElfCardFooter>
  </ElfCard>
</template>
```

### Dialog

Accessible modal dialog on Reka UI: focus trap, Escape to close, focus restore.

Components: `ElfDialog`, `ElfDialogTrigger`, `ElfDialogContent`, `ElfDialogHeader`, `ElfDialogTitle`, `ElfDialogDescription`, `ElfDialogFooter`, `ElfDialogClose`, `ElfDialogOverlay`

Props:

- `ElfDialog open / defaultOpen` (boolean): Controlled (v-model:open) or initial open state.
- `ElfDialogContent showCloseButton` (boolean, default true): Show the corner close button.
- `ElfDialogFooter showCloseButton` (boolean, default false): Append a Close button to the footer.

Slots:

- ElfDialogTrigger and ElfDialogClose: use as-child with an ElfButton

Accessibility:

- Always include ElfDialogTitle and ElfDialogDescription.
- Do not stack dialogs.

Examples:

#### Controlled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfDialog, ElfDialogContent, ElfDialogDescription, ElfDialogHeader, ElfDialogTitle } from '@elf/ui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
    <ElfButton variant="outline" @click="open = true">
      Open dialog
    </ElfButton>
    <span class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">open = {{ open }}</span>
    <ElfDialog v-model:open="open">
      <ElfDialogContent>
        <ElfDialogHeader>
          <ElfDialogTitle>Controlled dialog</ElfDialogTitle>
          <ElfDialogDescription>The open state lives in your component.</ElfDialogDescription>
        </ElfDialogHeader>
      </ElfDialogContent>
    </ElfDialog>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfDialog, ElfDialogClose, ElfDialogContent, ElfDialogDescription, ElfDialogFooter, ElfDialogHeader, ElfDialogTitle, ElfDialogTrigger, ElfInput } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfDialog>
    <ElfDialogTrigger as-child>
      <ElfButton variant="outline">
        Edit profile
      </ElfButton>
    </ElfDialogTrigger>
    <ElfDialogContent>
      <ElfDialogHeader>
        <ElfDialogTitle>Edit profile</ElfDialogTitle>
        <ElfDialogDescription>Update your display name. Save when you are done.</ElfDialogDescription>
      </ElfDialogHeader>
      <ElfInput aria-label="Display name" placeholder="Display name" />
      <ElfDialogFooter>
        <ElfDialogClose as-child>
          <ElfButton variant="outline">
            Cancel
          </ElfButton>
        </ElfDialogClose>
        <ElfButton>Save</ElfButton>
      </ElfDialogFooter>
    </ElfDialogContent>
  </ElfDialog>
</template>
```

#### Destructive

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfDialog, ElfDialogContent, ElfDialogDescription, ElfDialogFooter, ElfDialogHeader, ElfDialogTitle, ElfDialogTrigger } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfDialog>
    <ElfDialogTrigger as-child>
      <ElfButton variant="destructive">
        Delete match log
      </ElfButton>
    </ElfDialogTrigger>
    <ElfDialogContent>
      <ElfDialogHeader>
        <ElfDialogTitle>Delete match log?</ElfDialogTitle>
        <ElfDialogDescription>This action cannot be undone.</ElfDialogDescription>
      </ElfDialogHeader>
      <ElfDialogFooter show-close-button>
        <ElfButton variant="destructive">
          Delete
        </ElfButton>
      </ElfDialogFooter>
    </ElfDialogContent>
  </ElfDialog>
</template>
```

### Tabs

Switch between related views. Roving focus and arrow-key navigation on Reka UI.

Components: `ElfTabs`, `ElfTabsList`, `ElfTabsTrigger`, `ElfTabsContent`

Props:

- `ElfTabs defaultValue / modelValue` (string): Initial or v-model selected tab value.
- `ElfTabsTrigger value` (string): Required; must match an ElfTabsContent value.
- `ElfTabsContent value` (string): Required; panel for the matching trigger.

Accessibility:

- Give ElfTabsList an aria-label.
- Use tabs for peer views, not for step-by-step flows.

Examples:

#### Controlled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfTabs, ElfTabsContent, ElfTabsList, ElfTabsTrigger } from '@elf/ui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const tab = ref('code')
</script>

<template>
  <ElfTabs v-model="tab" activation-mode="manual" class="w-full max-w-md">
    <ElfTabsList aria-label="Editor">
      <ElfTabsTrigger value="code">
        Code
      </ElfTabsTrigger>
      <ElfTabsTrigger value="preview">
        Preview
      </ElfTabsTrigger>
      <ElfTabsTrigger value="history" disabled>
        History
      </ElfTabsTrigger>
    </ElfTabsList>
    <ElfTabsContent value="code" class="text-sm">
      Selected: {{ tab }}. With manual activation, arrows move focus and Enter or Space selects.
    </ElfTabsContent>
    <ElfTabsContent value="preview" class="text-sm">
      Selected: {{ tab }}.
    </ElfTabsContent>
  </ElfTabs>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfTabs, ElfTabsContent, ElfTabsList, ElfTabsTrigger } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfTabs default-value="overview" class="w-full max-w-md">
    <ElfTabsList aria-label="Sections">
      <ElfTabsTrigger value="overview">
        Overview
      </ElfTabsTrigger>
      <ElfTabsTrigger value="members">
        Members
      </ElfTabsTrigger>
      <ElfTabsTrigger value="settings">
        Settings
      </ElfTabsTrigger>
    </ElfTabsList>
    <ElfTabsContent value="overview" class="text-sm">
      Team overview and recent activity.
    </ElfTabsContent>
    <ElfTabsContent value="members" class="text-sm">
      Member list and roles.
    </ElfTabsContent>
    <ElfTabsContent value="settings" class="text-sm">
      Workspace settings.
    </ElfTabsContent>
  </ElfTabs>
</template>
```

### VisuallyHidden

Hides content visually while keeping it in the accessibility tree. Use it for icon-button names, hidden labels and table captions.

Components: `ElfVisuallyHidden`

Props:

- `as` (string | Component, default span): Element to render.
- `asChild` (boolean, default false): Render the child element with the hiding styles (attribute: as-child).
- `feature` ('focusable' | 'fully-hidden', default focusable): fully-hidden also removes the content from the accessibility tree and tab order (aria-hidden, tabindex -1).
- `class` (string | array | object): Merged onto the element.

Slots:

- default: the hidden content (text, or an element with as-child)

Accessibility:

- Prefer visible text. Use this only where a visual label would be redundant.
- Keep fully-hidden for decorative helpers; never put real content in it.

Examples:

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfVisuallyHidden } from '@elf/ui'
import { Trash2 } from '@lucide/vue'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfButton variant="outline" size="icon">
    <Trash2 />
    <ElfVisuallyHidden>Delete item</ElfVisuallyHidden>
  </ElfButton>
</template>
```

#### Hidden Label

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfInput, ElfVisuallyHidden } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <form class="flex w-72 items-center gap-2" role="search" @submit.prevent>
    <label for="visually-hidden-search">
      <ElfVisuallyHidden>Search members</ElfVisuallyHidden>
    </label>
    <ElfInput id="visually-hidden-search" type="search" placeholder="Search members" />
  </form>
</template>
```

#### Table Caption

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfVisuallyHidden } from '@elf/ui'

const rows = [
  { name: 'Ayşe Demir', role: 'Captain', status: 'Active' },
  { name: 'Mert Kaya', role: 'Programming lead', status: 'Active' },
  { name: 'Elif Yıldız', role: 'Mentor', status: 'On leave' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <table class="w-full max-w-md border-collapse text-left text-sm">
    <ElfVisuallyHidden as="caption">
      Team roster with role and status
    </ElfVisuallyHidden>
    <thead>
      <tr class="border-b border-border text-muted-foreground">
        <th scope="col" class="py-2 pr-4 font-medium">
          Name
        </th>
        <th scope="col" class="py-2 pr-4 font-medium">
          Role
        </th>
        <th scope="col" class="py-2 font-medium">
          Status
        </th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr v-for="row in rows" :key="row.name" class="border-b border-border">
        <td class="py-2 pr-4">
          {{ row.name }}
        </td>
        <td class="py-2 pr-4">
          {{ row.role }}
        </td>
        <td class="py-2">
          {{ row.status }}
        </td>
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</template>
```

### Label

Accessible label for a form control. Renders a native label; clicking it focuses or toggles the control.

Components: `ElfLabel`

Props:

- `for` (string): The id of the control the label belongs to.
- `as` (string | Component, default label): Element to render.
- `asChild` (boolean, default false): Render the child element with Label styling (attribute: as-child).
- `class` (string | array | object): Merged with base classes.

Slots:

- default: label text

Accessibility:

- Connect every control with for and a matching id.
- Put the control before the label and give it the peer class so peer-disabled dims the label.

Examples:

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfInput, ElfLabel } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-72 gap-2">
    <ElfLabel for="label-email">
      Email
    </ElfLabel>
    <ElfInput id="label-email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Disabled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfInput, ElfLabel } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <!-- The input comes first and carries `peer`, so the label can dim itself with `peer-disabled`. -->
  <div class="flex w-72 flex-col-reverse gap-2">
    <ElfInput id="label-member-id" class="peer" disabled model-value="FRC-10202" />
    <ElfLabel for="label-member-id">
      Member ID
    </ElfLabel>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Required

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfInput, ElfLabel } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-72 gap-2">
    <ElfLabel for="label-team-name">
      Team name
      <span aria-hidden="true" class="text-[color-mix(in_oklab,var(--color-destructive)_55%,white)]">*</span>
    </ElfLabel>
    <ElfInput id="label-team-name" required placeholder="Novatron Robotics" />
  </div>
</template>
```

#### With Checkbox

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfLabel } from '@elf/ui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const accepted = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
    <input id="label-terms" v-model="accepted" type="checkbox" class="size-4 accent-primary">
    <ElfLabel for="label-terms">
      Accept the team code of conduct
    </ElfLabel>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Separator

Horizontal or vertical divider. Decorative by default; set decorative to false to expose role=separator.

Components: `ElfSeparator`

Props:

- `orientation` ('horizontal' | 'vertical', default horizontal): Direction of the line. A vertical separator needs a parent with a height.
- `decorative` (boolean, default true): When true the element is hidden from assistive technology (role none).
- `as` (string | Component, default div): Element to render.
- `class` (string | array | object): Merged with base classes.

Accessibility:

- Use decorative="false" only when the divider separates meaningful regions.
- Do not use a separator as the only cue between sections.

Examples:

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfSeparator } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="w-72">
    <div class="space-y-1">
      <h4 class="text-sm leading-none font-medium">
        Novatron Robotics
      </h4>
      <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        FIRST Robotics Competition team 10202.
      </p>
    </div>
    <ElfSeparator class="my-4" />
    <p class="text-sm">
      Istanbul, Turkey
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Semantic

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfSeparator } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="w-72 text-sm">
    <p>Season summary</p>
    <!-- Not decorative: announced as a separator because it divides two regions of content. -->
    <ElfSeparator :decorative="false" class="my-3" />
    <p class="text-muted-foreground">
      Event results
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Vertical

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfSeparator } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex h-5 items-center gap-4 text-sm">
    <span>Docs</span>
    <ElfSeparator orientation="vertical" />
    <span>Examples</span>
    <ElfSeparator orientation="vertical" />
    <span>Changelog</span>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### With Label

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfSeparator } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-72 gap-4">
    <ElfButton>Sign in with your member account</ElfButton>
    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase">
      <ElfSeparator class="flex-1" />
      or
      <ElfSeparator class="flex-1" />
    </div>
    <ElfButton variant="outline">
      Request access
    </ElfButton>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Kbd

Keyboard key hint. A native kbd element; ElfKbdGroup keeps the keys of one shortcut together.

Components: `ElfKbd`, `ElfKbdGroup`

Props:

- `as` (string | Component, default kbd): Element to render (both parts).
- `asChild` (boolean, default false): Render the child element with Kbd styling (attribute: as-child).
- `class` (string | array | object): Merged with base classes (both parts).

Slots:

- default: key name or an icon (icon-only keys need ElfVisuallyHidden text)

Accessibility:

- Icon-only keys need visually hidden text naming the key (aria-label is not valid on kbd).
- A hint is not a control: keep the action reachable another way.

Examples:

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfKbd } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
    <ElfKbd>Esc</ElfKbd>
    <ElfKbd>Enter</ElfKbd>
    <ElfKbd>Tab</ElfKbd>
    <ElfKbd>K</ElfKbd>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Group

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfKbd, ElfKbdGroup } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
    Press
    <ElfKbdGroup>
      <ElfKbd>Ctrl</ElfKbd>
      <span aria-hidden="true">+</span>
      <ElfKbd>K</ElfKbd>
    </ElfKbdGroup>
    to open the command menu.
  </p>
</template>
```

#### In Button

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfKbd } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
    <ElfButton variant="outline">
      Search <ElfKbd>/</ElfKbd>
    </ElfButton>
    <ElfButton>
      Save <ElfKbd class="border-transparent bg-primary-foreground/15 text-primary-foreground">S</ElfKbd>
    </ElfButton>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### With Icons

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfKbd, ElfKbdGroup, ElfVisuallyHidden } from '@elf/ui'
import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, CornerDownLeft } from '@lucide/vue'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
      <ElfKbdGroup>
        <ElfKbd>
          <ArrowUp aria-hidden="true" />
          <ElfVisuallyHidden>Arrow up</ElfVisuallyHidden>
        </ElfKbd>
        <ElfKbd>
          <ArrowDown aria-hidden="true" />
          <ElfVisuallyHidden>Arrow down</ElfVisuallyHidden>
        </ElfKbd>
      </ElfKbdGroup>
      Navigate results
    </div>
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
      <ElfKbd>
        <CornerDownLeft aria-hidden="true" />
        <ElfVisuallyHidden>Enter</ElfVisuallyHidden>
      </ElfKbd>
      Open the selected result
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Spinner

Indeterminate busy indicator. An SVG ring in a role=status region with a visually hidden label; inherits the text color.

Components: `ElfSpinner`

- size options: `sm`, `default`, `lg`, `xl` (default `default`)

Props:

- `size` (size union, default default): Diameter: sm, default, lg, xl.
- `label` (string, default Loading): Announced to assistive technology, not shown.
- `class` (string | array | object): Merged with base classes; set the color with a text utility.

Accessibility:

- Mount the spinner when work starts so the status is announced.
- Use a specific label when several spinners can appear.
- Animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

Examples:

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfSpinner } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfSpinner />
</template>
```

#### In Button

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfSpinner } from '@elf/ui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const saving = ref(false)

function save() {
  saving.value = true
  setTimeout(() => (saving.value = false), 1500)
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
    <ElfButton :disabled="saving" :aria-busy="saving" @click="save">
      <ElfSpinner v-if="saving" label="Saving changes" />
      {{ saving ? 'Saving' : 'Save changes' }}
    </ElfButton>
    <ElfButton variant="outline" disabled>
      <ElfSpinner label="Please wait" /> Please wait
    </ElfButton>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Page Loader

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfSpinner } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex w-72 flex-col items-center gap-3 border border-border p-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
    <ElfSpinner size="xl" class="text-primary" label="Loading the match schedule" />
    <p aria-hidden="true">
      Loading the match schedule
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Sizes

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfSpinner } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex items-center gap-6 text-primary">
    <ElfSpinner size="sm" label="Loading, small" />
    <ElfSpinner label="Loading, default" />
    <ElfSpinner size="lg" label="Loading, large" />
    <ElfSpinner size="xl" label="Loading, extra large" />
  </div>
</template>
```

### Skeleton

Placeholder block shown while content loads. Decorative (aria-hidden); size and shape come from classes.

Components: `ElfSkeleton`

Props:

- `class` (string | array | object): Size and shape (h-4 w-40, size-10 rounded-full); merged with base classes.

Accessibility:

- Skeletons are aria-hidden: mark the loading region with aria-busy and render a visually hidden role=status message.
- The pulse stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

Examples:

#### Card

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfCard, ElfCardContent, ElfCardHeader, ElfSkeleton, ElfVisuallyHidden } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfCard class="w-full max-w-sm" aria-busy="true">
    <ElfVisuallyHidden role="status">
      Loading robot status
    </ElfVisuallyHidden>
    <ElfCardHeader>
      <ElfSkeleton class="h-5 w-32" />
      <ElfSkeleton class="h-4 w-48" />
    </ElfCardHeader>
    <ElfCardContent class="grid gap-2">
      <ElfSkeleton class="h-24 w-full" />
      <ElfSkeleton class="h-4 w-3/4" />
    </ElfCardContent>
  </ElfCard>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfSkeleton } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
    <ElfSkeleton class="size-12 rounded-full" />
    <div class="grid gap-2">
      <ElfSkeleton class="h-4 w-60" />
      <ElfSkeleton class="h-4 w-44" />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### List

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfSkeleton } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ul class="grid w-full max-w-md gap-3" aria-busy="true" aria-label="Members, loading">
    <li v-for="n in 4" :key="n" class="flex items-center gap-3 border border-border p-3">
      <ElfSkeleton class="size-8 rounded-full" />
      <div class="grid flex-1 gap-1.5">
        <ElfSkeleton class="h-3.5 w-1/2" />
        <ElfSkeleton class="h-3 w-3/4" />
      </div>
    </li>
  </ul>
</template>
```

#### Loading State

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfSkeleton, ElfVisuallyHidden } from '@elf/ui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const loading = ref(true)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-72 gap-3">
    <div :aria-busy="loading" class="grid gap-2">
      <template v-if="loading">
        <ElfVisuallyHidden role="status">
          Loading profile
        </ElfVisuallyHidden>
        <ElfSkeleton class="h-5 w-40" />
        <ElfSkeleton class="h-4 w-56" />
      </template>
      <template v-else>
        <h4 class="text-sm leading-none font-medium">
          Ayşe Demir
        </h4>
        <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Team captain, Istanbul
        </p>
      </template>
    </div>
    <ElfButton variant="outline" size="sm" class="w-fit" @click="loading = !loading">
      {{ loading ? 'Show loaded content' : 'Show loading state' }}
    </ElfButton>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Textarea

Multi-line text input with v-model and optional auto-grow. A native textarea: all native attributes fall through.

Components: `ElfTextarea`

Props:

- `modelValue` (string): Bound with v-model.
- `defaultValue` (string): Initial value when uncontrolled.
- `autoResize` (boolean, default false): Grow and shrink with the content (attribute: auto-resize). Cap with a max-h-* class.
- `invalid` (boolean, default false): Sets aria-invalid="true" and the destructive border and ring.
- `rows` (number, default 3): Visible lines; the minimum height with autoResize.
- `maxlength` (number): Maximum number of characters.
- `class` (string | array | object): Merged with base classes.

Accessibility:

- Always provide a visible label (ElfLabel for=) or aria-label; a placeholder is not a label.
- Describe errors in text and link them with aria-describedby (ElfField does this).

Examples:

#### Auto Resize

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfLabel, ElfTextarea } from '@elf/ui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const notes = ref('Swerve module 3 drifts under load.\nCheck the encoder offset before the next match.')
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-80 gap-2">
    <ElfLabel for="textarea-notes">
      Pit notes
    </ElfLabel>
    <ElfTextarea id="textarea-notes" v-model="notes" auto-resize :rows="2" class="max-h-48" />
    <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      Grows with the text up to 12rem, then scrolls.
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Character Count

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfLabel, ElfTextarea } from '@elf/ui'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const max = 140
const post = ref('')
const remaining = computed(() => max - post.value.length)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-80 gap-2">
    <ElfLabel for="textarea-post">
      Post
    </ElfLabel>
    <ElfTextarea
      id="textarea-post"
      v-model="post"
      :maxlength="max"
      placeholder="What happened at the event?"
      aria-describedby="textarea-post-count"
    />
    <p id="textarea-post-count" class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      {{ remaining }} characters left
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfTextarea } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfTextarea aria-label="Message" placeholder="Write a message to the team" class="w-80" />
</template>
```

#### Disabled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfTextarea } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfTextarea disabled aria-label="Archived note" model-value="This note is archived and can no longer be edited." class="w-80" />
</template>
```

#### Invalid

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfLabel, ElfTextarea } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-80 gap-2">
    <ElfLabel for="textarea-bio">
      Bio
    </ElfLabel>
    <ElfTextarea
      id="textarea-bio"
      invalid
      model-value="Hi"
      aria-describedby="textarea-bio-error"
    />
    <p id="textarea-bio-error" class="text-sm text-[color-mix(in_oklab,var(--color-destructive)_55%,white)]">
      Write at least 20 characters.
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Field

Form row: label, one control, description and error wired through id, for, aria-describedby and aria-invalid. Wrap the control in ElfFieldControl; works with ElfInput, ElfTextarea and native controls.

Components: `ElfField`, `ElfFieldControl`, `ElfFieldLabel`, `ElfFieldDescription`, `ElfFieldError`

- orientation options: `vertical`, `horizontal` (default `vertical`)

Props:

- `ElfField label` (string): Label text (or use the label slot / ElfFieldLabel).
- `ElfField description` (string): Helper text; the control references it with aria-describedby.
- `ElfField error` (string): Error message (role=alert). Sets aria-invalid on the control. Show it after blur or submit.
- `ElfField invalid` (boolean, default false): Invalid state without a message.
- `ElfField required` (boolean, default false): Adds a label marker and aria-required on the control.
- `ElfField disabled` (boolean, default false): Disables the control and dims the label.
- `ElfField orientation` ('vertical' | 'horizontal', default vertical): Horizontal puts the label beside the control from the sm breakpoint.
- `ElfField id` (string): Control id; generated by default.
- `class` (string | array | object): Accepted by every part; merged with base classes.

Slots:

- ElfField default: exactly one ElfFieldControl wrapping the control
- ElfField label / description / error: rich content instead of the props

Accessibility:

- Wrap exactly one control in ElfFieldControl; it merges id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, aria-required and disabled onto the child.
- Do not render errors on first load: the error has role=alert and is announced when it appears.

Examples:

#### Default

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfField, ElfFieldControl, ElfInput } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfField label="Email" description="We only use it to send match reminders." class="w-80">
    <ElfFieldControl>
      <ElfInput type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
    </ElfFieldControl>
  </ElfField>
</template>
```

#### Horizontal

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfField, ElfFieldControl, ElfInput } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid w-full max-w-xl gap-5">
    <ElfField label="Display name" description="Visible to other team members." orientation="horizontal">
      <ElfFieldControl>
        <ElfInput model-value="Ayşe Demir" />
      </ElfFieldControl>
    </ElfField>
    <ElfField label="Member ID" description="Assigned by the team lead." orientation="horizontal" disabled>
      <ElfFieldControl>
        <ElfInput model-value="FRC-10202-014" />
      </ElfFieldControl>
    </ElfField>
  </div>
</template>
```

#### Required

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfField, ElfFieldControl, ElfInput } from '@elf/ui'
</script>

<template>
  <ElfField label="Team number" description="The FRC team you are registering for." required class="w-80">
    <ElfFieldControl>
      <ElfInput inputmode="numeric" model-value="10202" />
    </ElfFieldControl>
  </ElfField>
</template>
```

#### Validation

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfButton, ElfField, ElfFieldControl, ElfInput, ElfTextarea } from '@elf/ui'
import { computed, reactive, ref } from 'vue'

const form = reactive({ email: '', message: '' })
const touched = ref(false)
const submitted = ref(false)

const errors = computed(() => ({
  email: /^\S[^\s@]*@\S+\.\S+$/.test(form.email) ? '' : 'Enter a valid email address.',
  message: form.message.trim().length >= 10 ? '' : 'Write at least 10 characters.',
}))

function submit() {
  touched.value = true
  submitted.value = !errors.value.email && !errors.value.message
}
</script>

<template>
  <form class="grid w-80 gap-5" novalidate @submit.prevent="submit">
    <ElfField label="Email" required :error="touched ? errors.email : ''">
      <ElfFieldControl>
        <ElfInput v-model="form.email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
      </ElfFieldControl>
    </ElfField>
    <ElfField label="Message" description="At least 10 characters." required :error="touched ? errors.message : ''">
      <ElfFieldControl>
        <ElfTextarea v-model="form.message" />
      </ElfFieldControl>
    </ElfField>
    <ElfButton type="submit" class="w-fit">
      Send
    </ElfButton>
    <p v-if="submitted" role="status" class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      Message sent.
    </p>
  </form>
</template>
```

#### With Textarea

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ElfField, ElfFieldControl, ElfTextarea } from '@elf/ui'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const bio = ref('Hi')
</script>

<template>
  <ElfField
    label="Bio"
    description="Shown on your public member card."
    error="Write at least 20 characters."
    class="w-80"
  >
    <ElfFieldControl>
      <ElfTextarea v-model="bio" auto-resize />
    </ElfFieldControl>
  </ElfField>
</template>
```

## Exports from "@elf/ui"

- Components: `ElfButton`, `ElfInput`, `ElfBadge`, `ElfCard`, `ElfCardAction`, `ElfCardContent`, `ElfCardDescription`, `ElfCardFooter`, `ElfCardHeader`, `ElfCardTitle`, `ElfDialog`, `ElfDialogClose`, `ElfDialogContent`, `ElfDialogDescription`, `ElfDialogFooter`, `ElfDialogHeader`, `ElfDialogOverlay`, `ElfDialogTitle`, `ElfDialogTrigger`, `ElfTabs`, `ElfTabsContent`, `ElfTabsList`, `ElfTabsTrigger`, `ElfVisuallyHidden`, `ElfLabel`, `ElfSeparator`, `ElfKbd`, `ElfKbdGroup`, `ElfSpinner`, `ElfSkeleton`, `ElfTextarea`, `ElfField`, `ElfFieldControl`, `ElfFieldDescription`, `ElfFieldError`, `ElfFieldLabel`
- Helpers: `cn`, `buttonVariants`, `badgeVariants`, `elfThemes`
- Types: `ButtonProps`, `ButtonVariants`, `BadgeProps`, `BadgeVariants`, `ElfTheme`
